hero.title: Senior Software Engineer
hero.description: I build web applications and platforms for e-commerce, logistics, and growing businesses. I use AI tools to streamline development, ship faster, and create efficient solutions tailored to each business.

planning.title: Strategy & Architecture
planning.description: I turn your business goals into well-defined digital solutions. I help you plan features, choose technologies, and design your product's structure before it gets built.

development.title: Full-Stack Development
development.description: I build custom web applications, internal platforms, and websites. I create fast, scalable solutions tailored to your business needs, from the initial idea to launch.

analysis.title: AI & Automation
analysis.description: I implement AI solutions that save time and simplify processes. From chatbots that answer questions and serve customers to automations that connect your tools and cut manual work.

consulting.title: Technical Consulting & Audit
consulting.description: I evaluate your systems and websites to detect performance, security, and maintenance issues. I propose concrete improvements to optimize your resources and get your technology ready to grow.

contact.description: Interested in working together? I look forward to hearing from you.
